choice.basis: The state incidence map visually encodes incidence via a color gradient: pale yellow (High, near 100) to dark burgundy (Low, near 0). Utah (UT) is colored dark burgundy, indicating the lowest incidence level among the three options. West Virginia (WV) is colored pale yellow, indicating the highest incidence level. Alabama (AL) is colored orange, indicating a moderate level (between 40 and 60). The task requires routing to the highest-incidence state among the three options. Since Utah is the lowest and Alabama is moderate, West Virginia is the only option that meets the 'highest-incidence' criterion.
choice.option_label: Open West Virginia (WV) incidence detail for priority follow-up
